statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6464 (PostgreSQL psql COPY FROM STDIN early failure processes data lines as psql commands) in 16.15 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6464/ lists 16.15 as the fixed release for major version 16 (versions before 16.15 are affected), and the 16.15 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.15/, list this CVE. The fix is two commits on the REL_16_STABLE branch tagged Security: CVE-2026-6464, both in the REL_16_15 release tag and not in REL_16_14: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/2bdfd5cdcc09a04d281da6b731715016417f466e, which teaches psql to skip the in-line data rows of COPY ... FROM STDIN after a failure (src/bin/psql and the psql lexer in src/fe_utils/psqlscan.l), and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/db96e87f93016930b9bc2cf5ec46188f27837e3f, a preparatory change that saves and restores more psql lexer state. psql ships in the postgresql16-client package as /usr/libexec/postgresql16/psql; that package is built from the same APKBUILD and carries the same version as the postgresql16 package. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. It lists CVE-2026-6464 under its 16.15-r0 secfixes. We checked psql, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/psql in the postgresql16-client package, in every postgresql16 build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-28, on both x86_64 and aarch64 (package checksums verified against the package index): 16.13-r0 and 16.14-r0 report PostgreSQL 16.13 and 16.14 and are affected, while 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 report PostgreSQL 16.15 and 16.16 and carry the fix. As a check, psql contains the message 'unexpected COPY_IN result, aborting connection', which the fix adds, in 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 on both architectures, and the same file in 16.13-r0 and 16.14-r0 does not. 16.15-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6464, psql processing in-line data rows as psql commands when COPY FROM STDIN or \copy FROM STDIN fails before the server asks for input rows, which may let a server administrator elicit execution of those lines as psql commands, in 17.11. Within major version 17, releases before 17.11 are affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6464/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.11/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.11-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6438-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6464. The fixed version is this owner's first rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, which packages PostgreSQL 17.11 and is no longer in the repository. Every build published now carries the fix: psql, which ships in the postgresql-client-17 package of each rebuild of Debian's source and in the postgresql-17 package of the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 builds, reports PostgreSQL 17.11 in the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and in the 17.11-1 build, and PostgreSQL 17.12 in the 17.12-0 build and in the rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1, on amd64 and arm64. The earlier rebuild of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, packages PostgreSQL 17.10; it is affected and sorts below the fixed version.
